ballet-vision:
THE VISION BEHIND THE CREATION

An icon of hip-hop culture. Reimagined.

Few pieces of jewellery have become as deeply connected to hip-hop culture as the Jesus Piece.

Popularized by The Notorious B.I.G., it became a symbol of identity, ambition and personal expression.

For Samuel Ballet, BERETE set out to reinterpret this cultural icon through its own artistic vision.

A sculpted rose-gold face, covered in a mosaic of diamonds, is crowned by 32 pear-shaped diamonds set in white gold — creating a striking contrast and giving the iconic silhouette a new dimension.

A legacy respected. An icon reimagined.

ballet-details:
01 — THE CROWN OF 32 DIAMONDS
Thirty-two pear-shaped diamonds form the white-gold crown, giving the creation its distinctive sculptural character.

02 — THE PRECISION OF THE CLAWS
Each pear-shaped diamond is individually secured with carefully executed claws, designed to enhance the appearance of the stones while preserving their distinctive silhouettes.

03 — THE DIAMOND MOSAIC
Round diamonds of varying sizes are arranged across the rose-gold face, following its sculpted contours and creating depth and texture.

04 — THE CONTRAST OF GOLD
The brilliance of the white-gold crown contrasts with the warmth of the rose-gold face, bringing two different sculptural expressions together.
tillman-hero:
MT — NEXUS CROSS
A Symbol of Connection

Created exclusively for Malik Tillman
tillman-vision:
THE VISION BEHIND THE CREATION

A symbol of faith. A vision without boundaries.

Following his first bespoke creation with BERETE, the original MT pendant, Malik Tillman returned with a new idea: a cross.

This time, he gave us complete creative freedom, with only one direction — the cross itself.

We reimagined this timeless symbol through a mosaic of bezel-set diamonds in varying sizes, creating an intricate composition where every stone contributes to the whole.

Paired with a custom infinity chain, the creation brings together faith, individuality and artistic expression.

One symbol. Endless possibilities.

tillman-details:
01 — THE BEZEL MOSAIC
At the heart of the cross, round diamonds of varying sizes are individually bezel-set and arranged into an intricate mosaic. The combination of different proportions creates a composition of depth and contrast.

02 — THE ROTATING MT SIGNATURE
A circular element at the centre of the cross features Malik Tillman's MT initials, continuing the visual identity established in his first BERETE pendant.
The central element is designed to rotate, bringing movement to the creation.

03 — THE EMERALD-CUT ARCHITECTURE
Emerald-cut diamonds form a geometric border around the central mosaic, introducing clean lines and a structured architectural contrast to the round stones.

04 — THE DIAMOND HALO
The outer silhouette is surrounded by larger round diamonds, each framed by a halo of smaller stones.
This continuous arrangement gives the cross its distinctive outline and striking visual presence.

05 — THE INFINITY CHAIN
The custom chain is composed of infinity-shaped links, each incorporating a cross motif set with baguette diamonds.
Between the infinity links, additional crosses featuring emerald-cut diamonds connect the entire necklace, creating a continuous pattern of interconnected symbols.

06 — THE SCULPTURAL BAIL
The pendant is suspended from a custom, diamond-shaped bail, designed as a rotated square with softly rounded corners.
Its interior features an intricate geometric composition of invisible-set baguette diamonds, with a cross motif in baguette setting at the centre.
The bail is designed as an integral decorative element rather than a conventional pendant attachment.
